contrast.note: From pixels, WCAG 2.x. BEFORE: ground = modal colour of the indicator row; mark = first ink cluster from the left (stale has no mark, so its 'mark' is the label's first glyph; older's is the 18px spinner ring); label = most extreme ink right of the mark. AFTER (D-M1 spinner): arc = the most contrasting saturated (accent) pixel inside the 16px ring, track = the most contrasting grey ring pixel, pill = modal colour of the pill box, label = most extreme ink on the pill. Ranges span the still plus every pre-release sequence frame (~300 ms, a partial rotation; the full rotation is `markSpin`).

markSpin.note: Cold open held 1.4 s (more than one 1 s rotation), capturePage() in a loop, pre-release frames only; arc/track per frame via markm.cjs. Reduced motion: CDP Emulation.setEmulatedMedia prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
